verification_report.summary: The proof is correct and complete. It validly counts permutations associated with each member of the antichain, proves those permutation classes are pairwise disjoint, derives the Lubell inequality, shows that the central binomial coefficient is maximal, and obtains the claimed bound. The family of all subsets of size floor(n/2) is correctly shown to be an antichain of the required cardinality, so equality is attained. The statement is self-contained, no prohibited proof patterns occur, and no external or fact-graph references require checking.
